hero.title: The Power of Fashion
hero.subtitle: Fashion arises where need meets desire. It protects us from the cold, but it also affirms who we are. It is born as a ritual of belonging, yet grows into a space of individual freedom. It may be ephemeral, but its meaning is eternal: fashion is memory, identity and future condensed into fabric and form.

roupasPage.title: Luxury Clothing
roupasPage.subtitle: The best of world fashion in women's clothing, gathered in a LUIGARAH online selection. Discover the style and high standard of pieces that convey creative talent and the innovative concepts of national and imported brands driving international fashion. A surprising collection ranging from Dolce Gabbana clothing to the cosmopolitan elegance of Stella McCartney and the sophistication of Givenchy. LUIGARAH brings you every current fashion trend and the world's best designers.

mulherPage.heroSubtitle: Sophistication and elegance that define your unique style
mulherPage.contrastText:
Every piece is carefully selected to reflect power,

grace and the essence of modern femininity
mulherPage.description1: Our women's collection celebrates the contemporary woman: strong, elegant and conscious. From impeccable tailoring to flowing dresses, every piece is a statement of style and refinement.
mulherPage.description2: Explore the world's greatest luxury brands, carefully curated to offer exclusivity and unmatched quality in every detail.

homemPage.heroSubtitle: Timeless sophistication for the modern man
homemPage.contrastText:
Where classic tailoring meets contemporary design,

creating the perfect balance between tradition and modernity
homemPage.description1: Our men's collection is dedicated to the man who values quality, elegance and attention to detail. Every piece is selected to build a versatile, sophisticated wardrobe.
homemPage.description2: From the world's greatest fashion houses, we bring you the very best in tailoring, luxury streetwear and refined accessories.

unissexPage.heroSubtitle: Style without borders, fashion without labels
unissexPage.contrastText:
Transcending gender, celebrating individuality.

Fashion that expresses who you really are
unissexPage.description1: Our unisex collection breaks barriers and redefines the concept of fashion. Versatile pieces that adapt to every style, body and identity, without compromising elegance or quality.
unissexPage.description2: Explore bold, timeless designs from the world's most innovative brands, created for those seeking authenticity and freedom of expression.

kidsPage.heroAlt: Kids' Style - Elegance from an Early Age
kidsPage.heroSubtitle: Elegance and comfort for little ones with big style
kidsPage.contrastText:
Where play meets sophistication.

Luxury fashion made to measure for childhood
kidsPage.description1: Our kids' collection combines the best of luxury design with the comfort and practicality children need. Every piece is designed to keep up with little ones on their daily adventures, in style.
kidsPage.description2: From the world's most prestigious brands, we select clothing that celebrates childhood without giving up sophistication and exceptional quality.

sobre.metaDescription: Discover Luigarah's story, our team and our commitment to excellence in the world of luxury fashion.
sobre.metaKeywords: about luigarah, luxury fashion, luigarah team, sarah hernandes, luigi rodrigo
sobre.tagline: Where luxury, exclusivity and elegance meet in every detail
sobre.essence1: Luigarah is a fictional portfolio project inspired by the world's best luxury fashion websites, such as Farfetch, Zara and Prada.
sobre.essence2: This website was created to showcase our talents and skills in several areas: UI/UX Design, Art, Creativity, Organization and Programming. Every detail was designed to create a sophisticated and functional visual experience.
sobre.essence3: Built with great professionalism, care and study, the Luigarah project represents our passion for creating elegant interfaces and memorable digital experiences.

jose.p1: At 57, José faced countless rejections in the fashion industry for not fitting the “traditional standards” as an older man. Coming from a humble family in the countryside of São Paulo, he dreamed of seeing diverse bodies represented on luxury runways.
jose.p2: When Luigarah opened its doors to models of every body type, José found his place. Today, at 64, he is one of the brand's main ambassadors, walking in international campaigns and inspiring thousands of young people who relate to his story.
jose.quote: At Luigarah, I learned that elegance isn't one-size-fits-all. Every body tells a story, and they all deserve to be celebrated.

rafael.p1: Rafael grew up fascinated by the intersection of art and technology. With a degree in Graphic Design, he took on the challenge of proving that a digital experience could be as luxurious and sophisticated as a physical boutique.
rafael.p2: After years working at startups, Rafael brought his revolutionary vision to Luigarah. He led the creation of interfaces that combine elegant minimalism with intuitive functionality, turning every click into a sensory experience.
rafael.quote: Design isn't just about how something looks, but how it makes you feel. At Luigarah, every pixel is a statement of elegance.

maria.p1: At 37 and with more than three decades of experience, Maria is living proof that true luxury lies in handcrafted details. She learned to sew at 12 from her grandmother, in a small village in the countryside of Minas Gerais.
maria.p2: When the fast-fashion industry threatened to wipe out traditional techniques, Maria found in Luigarah a place to share her ancestral knowledge. Today she leads haute couture workshops, teaching young seamstresses the art of creating pieces that last for generations.
maria.p3: Her hands, marked by years of dedication, turn fabrics into works of art. Every stitch carries history, resilience and the wisdom of someone who has watched fashion evolve without losing its essence.
maria.quote: A handmade piece carries the soul of whoever created it. That's what sets true luxury apart from mass production.

steffany.p1: Lady Steffany is synonymous with courage and style. As a drag queen and fashion executive, she turned her artistic expression into inspiring leadership, taking Luigarah's aesthetic to a new level of boldness and sophistication.
steffany.p2: Her journey began on independent stages, where she learned that fashion is identity and resistance. At Luigarah, Steffany leads capsule collections that celebrate diversity, sparkle and flawless technique — combining precise tailoring with innovative materials.
steffany.quote: Being luxury is honoring who you are. Drag taught me that elegance is also attitude.

irmaos.name: The <s>Steffany</s> Brothers
irmaos.p1: Tattooed, authentic and unconventional. The Steffany brothers design the architecture of Luigarah's concept stores and pop-ups, blending soft brutalism, scenic lighting and sustainable materials.
irmaos.p2: For them, every space is a sensory narrative: concrete meets velvet, steel converses with silk. The result? Spaces that showcase the pieces and welcome a diverse public without giving up sophistication.
irmaos.quote: Architecture is dressing the void. At Luigarah, we dress experiences with personality.

privacidade.metaDescription: How Luigarah collects, uses, shares and protects your personal data, in compliance with the LGPD.
privacidade.title: Privacy Policy
privacidade.intro: Luigarah respects your privacy and processes personal data in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD – Law No. 13,709/2018). This document describes how we collect, use, share and protect your information when you use our website and services.

s1.title: 1. Data we collect
s1.account: Account data: name, email, phone (when provided by you).
s1.browsing: Browsing data: IP address, device/OS, pages visited, essential and performance cookies.
s1.purchase: Purchase/delivery data: address, preferences and order history.

s2.title: 2. Legal basis and purposes
s2.text: We process data on the basis of performance of a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, legitimate interest (with impact assessment) and/or consent where applicable. Purposes include: authentication, order processing, fraud prevention, support, experience improvement and transactional communications.

s3.title: 3. Sharing
s3.text: We may share data with hosting, logistics and analytics providers, always under appropriate contracts and security measures. We do not sell personal data.

s4.title: 4. Cookies and similar technologies
s4.text: We use essential cookies for the website to work and, if you accept, performance/analytics cookies. You can manage preferences in your browser or in our consent banner (when enabled).

s5.title: 5. Your rights as a data subject
s5.r2: Access to and correction of data
s5.r4: Deletion of unnecessary or non-compliant data

s6.title: 6. Security and retention
s6.text: We adopt technical and administrative measures to protect your data. We keep it only for as long as needed for the stated purposes and legal deadlines (e.g. tax and anti-fraud obligations).

s7.title: 7. Children and teenagers
s7.text: Our services are not directed at children. If we identify improper collection, we will delete the data and close the associated account.

s8.title: 8. Data Protection Officer (DPO) contact
s8.text: To exercise your rights or ask questions, contact:

s9.title: 9. Changes to this Policy
s9.text: We may update this Policy to reflect improvements or legal requirements. The current version will always be available on this page.

termos.metaDescription: Terms of use for the Luigarah website and services, including responsibilities, limitations and rules of conduct.
termos.title: Terms of Service
termos.intro: These Terms govern the use of the Luigarah website and services. By accessing our platform, you agree to the conditions below. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

s1.title: 1. Registration and Account
s1.text: You must provide true and up-to-date information. Keep your credentials confidential. You are responsible for activities carried out with your account.

s2.title: 2. Purchases, Prices and Payments
s2.text: Prices, promotions and availability may change without notice. Orders are subject to confirmation and anti-fraud review. Payments are fictional; you will not expose any sensitive financial data.

s3.title: 3. Intellectual Property
s3.text: Trademarks, logos, texts, images and code belong to Luigarah and its inspirations Farfetch, Zara and Prada. Copying, modifying or commercially exploiting them without authorization is prohibited.

s4.title: 4. Conduct and Acceptable Use
s4.r1: Do not engage in illegal activities or activities that violate the rights of others.
s4.r2: Do not attempt to exploit vulnerabilities or bypass security mechanisms.
s4.r3: Do not post offensive, discriminatory or illegal content.

s5.title: 5. Disclaimers and Limitations
s5.text: The service is provided “as is”. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we do not guarantee uninterrupted availability and are not liable for indirect losses arising from the use of the website.

s6.title: 6. Privacy
s6.text: Use of the service is also governed by our <link>Privacy Policy</link>

s7.title: 7. Termination
s7.text: We may suspend or close accounts that violate these Terms or applicable law. You can request account deletion following the instructions in <link>Data/Account Deletion</link>

s8.title: 8. Changes
s8.text: We may update these Terms. Changes take effect once published on this page.
